products.name: NeverDull Premium Knife System (17-Piece)
products.blurb: The bigger version of their knife block — rust-resistant German stainless steel, built-in sharpener, and Ninja says it stays razor-sharp for 10-plus years. This is the full set if you want everything covered.
products.usage: This is the bigger version of the block I use — same built-in sharpener, just everything covered if you'd rather buy once.

products.name: NeverDull Knife Block Set (12-Piece)
products.blurb: German stainless steel knives with a built-in sharpener in the block itself — a few swipes and the edge is back. These are the knives I actually reach for in the kitchen, and they stay sharp for years, not weeks.
products.usage: The sharpener is built into the block, so it happens automatically every time I put a knife away. That's the only reason mine are still sharp.
